title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Acute Humanitarian Crisis Stream funding is implemented by Trócaire and partners to respond to sudden onset crises or spikes in chronic emergencies where-ever they occur. The responses aim to provide material relief assistance and services depending upon participants needs so the most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. Activites are dependent upon communities needs and capacities, Trócaire and partners skills and capacities and contextual and the wider humanitarian response. OBJECTIVES: 4.1.1: The most vulnerable women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can access and utilize humanitarian assistance and services that are principled, timely, of high quality and in line with their needs and prioritiesOUTCOMES: Acute Humanitarian Crisis Stream: Outcome 4.1The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs
